_comment: LISTEN-track fixture manifest (M4). Musical placeholder stems for the presentation axis: the owner listen (2026-08-19, drafts/_m4-owner-scores.md) falsified raw sines as listen material, so the ear track renders these while the accuracy corpus keeps data/audio/fixtures.json sines (goertzel/ratio math needs pure tones). Everything is A-minor at 120 bpm so cues sit in one harmonic world. All in-repo generated synthesis (GTA::Fixtures type=notes) — no third-party audio, ever; owner Reaper stems replace entries per docs/listen-track.md. LAW: dur_s of every entry MUST equal its gate-manifest counterpart (choreography timing — steal/duck/transition moments — depends on cue durations; test/listen_track_test.rb pins the mirror). Relative level bands follow KB music-production/production-fundamentals.md Game Audio Targets (music bed mid, ambient drone below everything, sfx cutting above music, UI clear-not-jarring); LUFS metering itself stays parked.

mstem_calm_6s._what: calm state music: warm triangle pad, 3 bars (Am | Fmaj7 | C), soft top line, slow-breathing A2 root drone. Loops at 3 bars.

mstem_combat_6s._what: combat state music: driving eighth-note square bass riff (Am), offbeat saw power-chord stabs, throbbing A1 pulse, bar-3 riser. Loops at 3 bars.

msfx_drone_4s._what: drone_low sfx: dark detuned-saw pair on A2 (+/-4 cents) over E2 + A1, slow tremolo. Ambient band: sits below everything (KB).

msfx_stinger_2s._what: boss1_spawn stinger: noise impact + pitch-drop hit (A3->A2) + decaying Am saw swell + high E5 tail. SFX band: must cut above the music bed (KB).

msfx_swarmpip_4s._what: filler_blip: soft E6 bell pip every 250 ms. Replays stack up to 47 voices at 1-tick offsets -> shimmering rain texture instead of a coherent sine wall; per-pip amp keeps the stack in the texture band.

mui_confirm_200ms._what: toll_paid: bright two-note confirm pluck A5 -> E6 (bell). UI band: clear but not jarring (KB).

mui_ping_1200ms._what: hud_ping: single soft E5 sonar bell with a long tail; 8 stack at 150 ms spacing in the cap replay -> a rising cascade.
